title: 1954 AHSME Problem 17
statement: The graph of the function \(f(x)=2x^3-7\) goes:

answerChoices.label: A
answerChoices.text: up to the right and down to the left

answerChoices.label: B
answerChoices.text: down to the right and up to the left

answerChoices.label: C
answerChoices.text: up to the right and up to the left

answerChoices.label: D
answerChoices.text: down to the right and down to the left

solutions.text:
The leading term \(2x^3\) controls the end behavior. As \(x\) tends to \(+\infty,\) \(f(x)\) tends to \(+\infty;\) as \(x\) tends to \(-\infty,\) \(f(x)\) tends to \(-\infty.\) Thus the graph goes up to the right and down to the left.

The correct answer is A.
hints: The constant \(-7\) shifts the graph vertically but does not change its end behavior
A positive odd-degree leading term tends to \(+\infty\) on the right and \(-\infty\) on the left
